text:
elaine: DeployBot scheduled the v2 routing shift for 2026-03-20 22:00Z — staged by region, 10% steps every 5m.
DeployBot: route-change queued: /api/v2 -> /api/v2-header-normalize, regions=[global], step=10%, window=60m. ticket=INF-4021
mason: heads-up: preflight canary-3 shows a spike of 422s for partner-pay webhook deliveries.
leo: checked gateway logs — middleware throws JSON parse errors when Content-Type header is missing. partner-pay sometimes sends POSTs without Content-Type.
drew: repro with curl: ```curl -X POST https://gateway.local/api/v2 -d '{"id":1}' --header "Content-Length: 7"``` no Content-Type -> gateway normalize flow alters header -> downstream 422.
elaine: that aligns with the canary failures. pause the rollout. we should not continue region-wide.
mason: applying an emergency pin on mobile-eu to v1 now.
DeployBot: PIN applied: route=mobile-eu -> pinned=v1 by mason at 2026-03-20T21:16:xxZ. note=emergency pin due to 422 spike.
sre-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-7891 (partner-pay 422 spike).
drew: mitigation proposal: deploy a non-destructive header shim that only adds Content-Type if missing (no rewrites), controlled by config toggle.
leo: agreed. I'll prepare a config flag `header_shim.add_if_missing=true` behind the rollout gate and test on canary-3.
elaine: prefer config toggle vs code change. test on canary-3 for 10m.
mason: toggling canary-3 now.
DeployBot: feature-flag update queued: header_shim.add_if_missing=true on canary-3.
leo: smoke logs show 422s returning to baseline on canary-3 after shim.
drew: plan: 1) keep mobile-eu pinned to v1 until partner confirms patch; 2) roll header_shim to all regions behind rollout gate; 3) update release notes and notify partner-pay.
elaine: who will update release notes and partner comms?
drew: I'll draft release notes and ping partner-pay support with rollback explanation.
sre-bot: timeline check — need overnight owner handoff.
mason: I'll cover the next 2 hours then hand to amy in ops.
elaine: ops checklist item for release-notes: "v2 header normalization: temporary add-if-missing shim deployed to mitigate missing Content-Type causing 422s; mobile-eu remains pinned to v1 until partner patching confirmed."
drew: adding DeployBot auto-rollback rule: if 4xx spike >3x baseline for 10m in any unpinned region, auto-pin that route.
DeployBot: auto-pin rule created: IF 4xx_spike AND region_unpinned -> pin to previous-stable.
leo: follow-ups: file INF-4022 to track permanent fix (normalize handling + partner compatibility) and include partner-pay in SLO sync.
elaine: summary for handoff: mobile-eu pinned to v1, header_shim tested on canary-3, shim to be rolled globally behind gate tomorrow morning, release notes drafted by drew, partner notified. handoff mason -> amy.
mason: handoff posted in ops channel, :white_check_mark:.
drew: I'll post final release-note snippet in #release-notes when ready.
elaine: holding rollout until global shim roll and partner confirmation.
DeployBot: thread closed by mason (pin applied).
